processing.input: Public high-quality MP3 preview of each CC0 recording, downloaded without authentication.
processing.trim: Removed the first second and selected up to 175 seconds for open water / 98 seconds for the cove.
processing.encoding: MP3, 96 kbit/s, 32000 Hz, stereo. No synthesized audio or pitch changes.
processing.playback: 48 to 72 second passages, varied start positions, six-second equal-power overlaps. Whole-file repeats are not used.
processing.delivery: MP3 bytes are delivered in an application/json base64 envelope so download managers do not hijack background audio fetches. HTTP compression can remove most base64 overhead.
